source_name: Uzņēmumu reģistrs — Register of Enterprises (company register open data)
organization: Latvijas Republikas Uzņēmumu reģistrs (UR / Register of Enterprises)
notes: Authoritative company register. Verified: downloaded register.csv = 128 MB, 485,134 entities. Keyed on regcode (11-digit registration number). Fields incl. legal form (SIA=Ltd, AS=plc, IK=sole trader), register type (Komercreģistrs), registered/terminated dates, address + postcode + atvk territory code, SEPA id. CC0-1.0 (public domain - no attribution required, commercial OK). Also XLSX/JSON/Parquet/SQLite/PostgreSQL dump. The open spine.

source_name: Gada pārskatu finanšu dati — Annual report financial data (structured)
fields_observed: financial_statements: id, file_id, legal_entity_registration_number, source_schema, source_type, year, year_started_on, year_ended_on, employees, rounded_to_nearest, currency, created_at

balance_sheets: cash, accounts_receivable, inventories, total_current_assets, fixed_assets, intangible_assets, total_non_current_assets, total_assets, current_liabilities, non_current_liabilities, provisions, equity, total_equities
income_statements: net_turnover, by_nature_*/by_function_* expenses, gross_profit, income_before/after_income_taxes, net_income
notes: STRUCTURED financial statement open data (rare and excellent). Four joined CSVs: financial_statements (report metadata - regcode, year, period, employees, currency), balance_sheets (Bilances), income_statements (Peļņas vai zaudējumu aprēķini), cash_flow_statements (Naudas plūsmas). Verified: downloaded financial_statements.csv = 204 MB, 1,970,094 annual reports; sampled balance/income schemas. Join financial_statements.legal_entity_registration_number -> register.regcode; balance/income via statement_id (=financial_statements.id) / file_id. CC0-1.0. EUR (also historical LVL). Includes EMPLOYEE counts.

Beneficial owners (patiesie labuma guvēji) as OPEN bulk CSV under CC0 - unusual; many EU states restricted BO access post-CJEU, Latvia keeps it open. PERSONAL DATA (GDPR). Join on regcode. Reachable (CKAN); not downloaded in full here.

source_name: UR officers / members / share capital / events (open datasets)
notes: The UR org on data.gov.lv publishes ~35 datasets (all CC0), incl. officers (amatpersonas), members/shareholders (dalībnieki), equity-capitals (pamatkapitāls + investments), historical names, insolvency processes (maksātnespējas-procesi), liquidations, reorganizations, sanctions risks. All keyed on regcode. Rich governance + ownership + events. Open.

source_name: VID — State Revenue Service VAT register / VIES (LV VAT)
notes: Latvian VAT (PVN reģistrācijas numurs) = LV + the 11-digit regcode. VID publishes VAT-payer lists; VIES validates a given number. The regcode is the open join key; VAT is derivable/validatable. Validation/enrichment.

organization: Vides aizsardzības un reģionālās attīstības ministrija (VARAM)
notes: National open-data portal (CKAN) hosting the UR datasets (org slug 'ur', ~35 datasets, CC0). The authoritative access point for all Latvian company open data. Verified: package_search/package_show working.
